rows.text: The Council's English introduction says King Fahd personally inaugurated the first session of the new Council on December 29, 1993, and that this council consisted of 60 members in addition to the chairman.
The same page says that on July 5, 1997 King Fahd decreed an increase in membership, and that the council now consists of a chairman and 90 members.
